name: Restore the collection state machine, bounded discovery and the coverage gap
request: Restore the collection state machine, bounded discovery and the coverage gap
checks: behavioural spot-check: 67 reported/66 usable/1 unusable gives accountedFor 67, coverageConfirmed true, exhausted true, gap 1, terminal completed_with_gap; dead pagination exhausts; drain bounded to 3 attempts; repeat and skip transitions refused; visibility pause claims nothing
updated the pagination-click test that encoded the infinite-loop behaviour, with the reason recorded in the test
result: Discovery now always terminates and hands over. Added COLLECTION_STATE with guarded, idempotent transitions (transitionCollection returns {changed}); coverage now settles on unique URLs + cards with no usable URL so 66 usable of 67 advertised is complete rather than an endless hunt, with the exact gap recorded; a pagination click no longer counts as growth and a control that reveals nothing 3 times is retired; the drain loop is bounded by MAX_FRUITLESS_DISCOVERY; added pauseForVisibility/canResumeFromVisibility and the collector-hidden stop reason. messages.ts carries the matching types.
